messages:
Aisha Patel: FYI customer report — their CI job started failing only on embeddings calls with 403 Insufficient scope. Other API calls (status, billing) are fine.

Miguel Ortiz: Any chance it's a quota vs scope issue? Customer account ID?

Aisha Patel: tenant-id: acme-ci-13. They shared a curl trace from the job. Error: `{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing: embeddings"}`

Corey Zhang: Can you paste the token claims? Usually we see `scopes` claim munged by provisioning.

Aisha Patel: Pasted snippet from CI environment (sanitized):
```
Authorization: Bearer eyJ...\n{ "sub":"svc-acme-ci","scopes":"inference\nembeddings\nrerank" }
```

Jessie Lowe: aha — the scope string contains newlines. Our provisioner expects comma/space-separated scopes and strips on whitespace, but the parser that writes claims normalizes only on spaces. The newline may be turning the claim into a multiline string that downstream splitters treat as single token -> only first scope (inference) recognized.

Miguel Ortiz: Repro: I created a token locally with `scopes: "inference\nembeddings"` and hit /v1/embeddings -> 403. If I change to `"inference embeddings"` or `"inference,embeddings"` it works.

Corey Zhang: Looks like the provisioner that ingests terraform outputs does: `join(" ", var.scopes)` but some pipeline step (the headless key generator) writes scopes separated by newlines. We should triage whether terraform provider or the keygen library is at fault.

infra-bot: @eng-infra assigned #INC-5421 (provisioner: normalize scope delimiter). Auto-scheduled rollback window 02:00 UTC for rollout.

Jessie Lowe: Short-term mitigation for customer: rotate the CI token using the UI or API curl with an explicit single-line scope string. Example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <org-admin-token>" 
 -d '{"name":"acme-ci-rot","scopes":"inference embeddings rerank"}'
```

Aisha Patel: I sent that as a workaround and provided the curl snippet. Customer confirmed they can repro and will rotate. They asked if there's a server-side fix — high priority for them.

Corey Zhang: Plan: 1) eng-infra to add normalization (trim + split on \n,\r,\t,space,comma) in the provisioner. 2) Add a lint/validator to the UI/API to reject multiline scope strings with actionable error. 3) Backfill a short migration that rewrites any stored keys that contain `\n` in their claims (audit-first).

Miguel Ortiz: I'll own the migration audit step and produce a list of affected tenant keys. Corey, can you review the provisioner PR?

Jessie Lowe: I'll follow up with the customer to confirm rotation and ETA. Adding notes to the customer ticket: prioritize a patch + UI validation. :white_check_mark:

Aisha Patel: Thanks team — marking as escalated on the ticket. Will update when customer confirms rotated key.

infra-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered for provisioner patch branch `fix/scope-normalize`. CI job queued.
